sources.title: Qwen3-VL-32B Heretic (MiniMax-H3 text encoder) — NVFP4
sources.snippet: An uncensored NVFP4-quantized text encoder for MiniMax-H3 video generation that fits on a single 16 GB GPU. Mixed-precision bake (mostly NVFP4, embedding left as INT8), preserves ConvRot rotation semantics, and includes the unrotate step required to avoid corrupted conditioning.

sources.title: Qwen 3 VL node for ComfyUI + Qwen 3 VL (Heretic, uncensored) model
sources.snippet: As for "heretic support" it is easy to add heretic model into the available QWEN 3.5 VL node from registry. It is needed to edit the file with the list of models by adding the " someuser/model-name " element into the array of model name in one or two .py files and add a SYSTEM_PROMPT options.

sources.title: AIAny - Qwen3-VL-32B Ultra Uncensored Heretic — MiniMax-H3 ComfyUI INT8 ...
sources.snippet: Provides ComfyUI-ready INT8 MiniMax‑H3 checkpoints (conditioning encoder plus optional generation tail) for a Heretic-edited Qwen3‑VL‑32B source; preserves the vision tower in BF16 and uses row-wise ConvRot INT8 quantization to reduce VRAM needs for ~32GB GPUs. Not a full Transformers generation repository.
